lines: Hello, dear my friends
We talked about our dreams
Do you remember the days we spent?
It's hard to become an adult, isn't it?
Let's go look for the things we were hiding
Cast off your messy heart
The clouds are swimming
Look up and leap out!
The rain has stopped, we sing together
We hold hands, I am smiling
You are smiling too, and surely like this
We will go to meet again
Hello, dear my friends
We awaken again
New days are beginning
It's hard to become an adult, but
Unexpectedly, every day
Might be enjoyable
Gather your scattered heart
Pour in water, the flowers bloom
Leap out!
The rain has stopped, we sing together
We hold hands, I am smiling
You are smiling too, and surely like this
We will move forward
Cast off your messy heart
The clouds are swimming, crossing the rainbow
Leap out!

We hold hands, I am smiling
You are smiling too, and surely like this
We will go to meet again
